text: THE DBIM DESIGN'S MINISTRY SECTION GAINS OUR SCHEME PORTALS, AND ITS PAGES MEET DBIM 3.0 §A.5.1. The scheme portals leave Our Organisation for a tab of their own, as they already had in the New design's home page and masthead: seven portals in the order every design now shares (`schemePortals()` in lib/website-shared/organisations.ts), each opening its page and ending in a link to the portal, which the registry now records once as `portalHref` for the masthead and DBIM alike. The old addresses under Our Organisation redirect. Card and summary text is each body's own lead or its "About…" paragraph; until now the cards showed a results ticker (NOS), a helpline banner (NMBA), counter strips glued onto sentences, and NCSC's description under the National Helpline Against Atrocities. Benchmarked against meity.gov.in, Our Organisation is now one list of every body with a Category filter and each body's mark on its card, as MeitY draws it; the reference build's per-type cards, which made a reader open a second page to see any body, redirect to the list. The Our Team chart draws the real hierarchy: the Union Minister, the two Ministers of State side by side, then the Secretary. Until now one Minister of State hung below the other. The office tables put the Additional Secretary & Financial Advisor with the Additional Secretary, by seniority. Our Performance adds the live site's Beneficiary Dashboard. `firstSentence()` no longer ends a sentence at "viz.".
